name: MacARM Input Buffer
description: Holds early jump clicks for a short time window (milliseconds) and presses once, inside the physics step, the moment a ground jump or orb click becomes legal. Optional uniform wave input delay.

assist-enabled.name: Enabled
assist-enabled.description: Hold early jump clicks and press once a jump is legal.

practice-only.name: Practice Mode only
practice-only.description: When on, the assist does nothing outside Practice Mode.

window-ms.name: Early-click window (ms)
window-ms.description: How long an early click may wait for a legal jump, in real milliseconds. 0 = vanilla.

wave-delay.name: Wave input delay (display frames)
wave-delay.description: Delays wave presses and releases equally. This is pure input lag, not an early-click window. 0 = off.

wave-guard.name: Wave duplicate-press filter
wave-guard.description: Drops a wave press that repeats with no release in between. Never presses for you.
